ai_summary: Aditya Birla Capital Limited's monitoring agency report for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, confirms no deviation in the utilization of the INR 4,000 Crore Preferential Issue proceeds from its stated objectives. Approximately INR 2,993 Crore was deployed towards growth objectives during the quarter, with the remaining INR 1,007 Crore held in liquid investments and bank accounts for future deployment. This indicates sound financial management and adherence to regulatory disclosures, with no red flags or material adverse impacts identified.
